name: Messina 1347

categories.label: Rat tokens penalty
categories.hint: Number of rat tokens. Also move back that many spaces on the popularity register BEFORE scoring registers.

categories.label: Points on registers
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên các thanh tiến trình
categories.hint: Sum of points shown on your current space of each register, after the rat move-back.

categories.label: Popularity register ranking
categories.hint: Enter your popularity register position (after rat move-back). 3-4p: 10/7/3 VP; 2p: 5 VP to first. Ties: see notes.

categories.label: Repopulated neighborhoods
categories.labelVi: Khu phố đã tái dân cư
categories.hint: Sum of points shown on each hex you repopulated (not the 2 pts on the repopulation tile).

categories.label: Scroll board: buildings
categories.hint: Points per building (value from your marker); max 6 buildings count. Quarantine improvements and workshops, not wagons.

categories.label: Scroll board: exotic goods
categories.hint: Points per boat tile / cargo taken, value from your marker.

categories.label: Scroll board: repopulation tiles
categories.labelVi: Bảng cuộn: ô tái dân cư
categories.hint: Points per repopulation tile in Messina, value from your marker.

categories.label: Remaining tokens
categories.hint: Coins + fire + major fire + lumber tokens; 1 VP per 3 (rounded down).

categories.label: Neighborhoods repopulated (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số khu phố tái dân cư (phân định hòa)

categories.label: Most valuable repopulated hex (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Khu phố giá trị nhất (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Highest point value among your repopulated hexes.

tiebreakers.description: Repopulated the neighborhood worth the most points

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Standard (non-advanced) side. Popularity register ties for the register bonus are broken by more fire tokens (a major fire counts as 2) in the rulebook; this is not modelled, so resolve manually and adjust. Printed values on the scroll board, registers and hex tiles are read from components, so they are entered as subtotals. Advanced variant (b-sides) adds extra scoring tracks and a repopulation ranking bonus (10/7/3, 7 in 2p); solo variant not modelled.
